scientific_question: Does a small additive task-selected output-side pass prevent the long-horizon row-Gram and endpoint drift left by the accepted hidden88 plus bounded-error-feedback c_proj path, despite losing to hidden-only stages in the prior one-step equal-budget screen?

inputs.trajectory_run_identity_sha256: see every snapshot metadata; execution must reject disagreement

teacher_forcing_protocol.phase_reset: Each layer/phase candidate starts at the exact dense phase-start c_proj weight.
teacher_forcing_protocol.per_step_target: Use only the already-recorded dense W[t+1]-W[t]. Remove the registered decoupled weight-decay radial term before chart fitting and apply weight decay exactly once to the candidate after the structured update.
teacher_forcing_protocol.causality: At step t, connectivity and coordinates may use only the candidate W[t], the dense update observed at t, and the candidate compression residual through t-1. No later dense weight is used until scoring.
teacher_forcing_protocol.error_feedback: E[t+1] = requested_corrected_update - actual_structured_update; corrected target adds decay*E[t].
teacher_forcing_protocol.interpretation: This is an optimistic representation/transport oracle because directions are teacher-forced from the dense run. Passing can authorize a real training-path implementation gate; failure rejects the structure. It is not language-model training evidence.

metrics.aggregate: energy-weight every metric and report the minimum cell; no aggregate can hide a nonfinite cell
metrics.coordinate_matching: output32 adds 32*(768/2)=12,288 coordinates, equal to 8*(3072/2) extra hidden coordinates; output64 matches 16 extra hidden stages

registered_decision_rule.candidate_pass: An output arm must beat its equal-coordinate hidden-only control by at least 1.10x in aggregate endpoint recovery, reduce aggregate row-Gram error by at least 25%, improve endpoint recovery in at least 16/20 cells, and remain finite in all cells.
registered_decision_rule.selection: Select output32 if it passes. Output64 is eligible only if output32 fails and output64 passes. If neither passes, reject additive sparse output transport.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_pass: Implement only the selected production optimizer arm, exact-resume tests, and a separately registered exact-config >=20% MFU preflight. No scientific training or larger rung is authorized by this plan.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_failure: No output-side production implementation, MFU run, language-model training, or larger rung.
